final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT zoneref AS z, articount AS a FROM scanfeatures), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(a) AS total FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.z AS z, s1.a AS a, CAST(s1.a AS REAL) / NULLIF(s2.total, 0) AS r FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.total IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS av FROM s3) SELECT s3.z, s3.a, s3.r, s3.r - s4.av AS d FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.av IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT 10
